description:
Elixir's `is_function/1` and `is_function/2` (Kernel guards) are unresolved in fz, in bodies and in guards:

    def main(), do: dbg([is_function(fn -> 0 end), is_function(fn (a, b) -> a + b end, 2), is_function(5)])

fz: "compiler2 lowering found unresolved direct runtime callee `is_function/1`"; in a guard: "compiler2 guard call `is_function/2` is unresolved in this namespace". Elixir prints [true, true, false].

Shape: the same Kernel guard-function pattern the guard-function ticket (fz-sc8.9) used for map_size/tuple_size/is_tuple: one definition serving bodies and guards, checked against Elixir on interp/run/build. The arity test must read a closure's arity at runtime; the type side should name "a function of arity n" through the type calculator, as `tuple` names every tuple (fz-sc8.28).

Needed by the Enum extremes ticket, whose max/2 tells a fallback (arity 0) from a sorter (arity 2) with these guards, as Elixir does. Not needed by the distiller.
title: is_function/1 and is_function/2, in bodies and guards
